clues.text: During a violent storm at sea, frightened sailors used these to find out who was to blame, and Jonah was picked.
After Judas was gone, the apostles prayed and then used these to choose Matthias over Joseph called Barsabbas.
At the cross, soldiers chose not to tear Jesus' seamless tunic and used these to decide who would get it.
On the Day of Atonement, Aaron used these over two goats to choose one for the LORD and one as the scapegoat.
At Shiloh, Joshua used these in the presence of the LORD to share out the land among the remaining tribes.
In Nehemiah's day, the people used these to pick one out of every ten to live in Jerusalem, the holy city.
The temple gatekeepers, young and old alike, used these to decide which gate each family would guard.
